_doc: Host classes for link replies (r5 COPY RULING fable-copy-1101-r5/r1-link). Read ONLY by scripts/credit_verify/proof/links.py. A host matches an entry when it IS the entry or a subdomain of it. outside_source = an outside source the user does not control (fetched, SSRF-safe, and eligible for the `status-doc-received --copy link` receipt); muso = Muso's own pages (Muso-UI class, no receipt, never fetched); shorteners = always unknown (never followed); skip = Intercom's own file hosts (those are attachments, filed as documents, not links). Anything not listed is unknown -> a person (r1_link_unknown). Adding a host is a policy change for r5: the ruling names Tidal, Genius, Discogs, AllMusic, ASCAP, BMI; 'a recognised distributor/label domain' is EMPTY until r5 names them.
